description: Kartikeya bwrap mount policy (product-neutral default). Override via $KART_SANDBOX_CONFIG or $WILLOW_HOME/kart-sandbox.json to add host/fleet-specific paths without editing code.

_security_notes.github_ro: ~/github is read-only by default; WILLOW_ROOT + its worktrees nest read-write on top. Hosts promote additional repos to RW via an override config.
_security_notes.ssh_dropped: ~/.ssh is not bound. SSH git uses SSH_AUTH_SOCK (via /run/user) + known_hosts (ro), both only on allow_net. Private keys never enter the sandbox.
_security_notes.creds_gated: credential_env_prefixes (and ~/.config/gh, ~/.netrc) are present only on allow_net. A no-network task gets zero credentials.
_security_notes.db_gated: db_env_prefixes and /var/run/postgresql socket bind are present only on allow_db. Default tasks cannot reach the local Postgres lane.
_security_notes.localhost_tier: # allow_localhost shares the host network namespace (loopback works) but still strips credentials. Weaker than --unshare-net; prefer over allow_net for local-only work.
_security_notes.tmp_tmpfs: /tmp + /dev/shm are private tmpfs, not host binds.
